topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: I can't believe we just found out about what's been going on with the Johnsons. I mean, all this time, living right next door to us, and we had no idea they were rolling in it like that. It's not that I'm upset they have it, it's just... I can't shake the thought of all the potlucks and carpool carpools, the times we thought we were in the same boat. Do you think they knew we had no clue? I feel like we should have known, like we should have been closer. Maybe I'll drop by with a pie, just to see how they're doing. It's weird, you know?
